what_this_is_NOT.not_a_selection: Approver event 55641's rule stands: a build produces a CANDIDATE. These digests are not selected artefacts until a recorded upgrade/source/security/platform/refresh event validates and explicitly selects them.
what_this_is_NOT.not_reproducible_across_days: W55361 measured this recipe's three moving inputs -- a tag FROM, whatever the apt mirror serves, and the provider version's postinstall fetching its own native binary. Two builds on different days will differ.
what_this_is_NOT.no_authentication_coverage: No credential was read, staged or exercised. No model turn was made. The provider runtime's mere presence at version 2.1.247 is an installation fact, not evidence that it can authenticate.
what_this_is_NOT.not_prospective_input_attestation: COPIED-INPUTS-207111.json establishes EQUALITY AT OBSERVATION TIME and nothing more: the checkout bytes and the artefact bytes agreed at the instant it ran. Review207195 corrected my earlier wording, which said it proved nothing had moved since the build -- a file changed after the build and changed back would satisfy it. A prospective input snapshot has to be taken BEFORE a build; the next build of either recipe should take one, and it must never be reconstructed retroactively.
